notes: Picked with BirdNET GeoModel (v3.0.4) for a normal trip through south-eastern Europe (Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Montenegro, Albania, North Macedonia, Bulgaria, Romania, Moldova and Greece): one or two places per country, mostly lowland (areas.json). A bird is in when its best-month score over those 16 places is at least 0.30 (about 175 birds): the farmland, town, wetland and woodland birds a visitor meets almost anywhere, including winter visitors. Hand-added because eBird's list names differ from the model's: Eurasian Wren, Common Reed Bunting; and Syrian Woodpecker, which the model rates low although it is widespread in the lowlands. Left out on purpose: northern winter visitors and vagrants (Whooper Swan, Black-throated Diver, Rough-legged Buzzard, Merlin, Smew, Bearded Tit, Common Goldeneye, Common Shelduck, Spotted Redshank, Little Stint, Common Ringed Plover) and the introduced Red Junglefowl. Birds that belong to one landscape sit in a region pack, which wins over the country rule: White-throated Dipper, Crested Tit, Willow Tit and Common Crossbill (mountains). The model is smoothed and blind to many regional specialists (Krüper's Nuthatch 0.04, Capercaillie 0.10, Ural Owl 0.04), so the packs are hand-picked, not cut from scores. The model scores no Cinereous Bunting, Black-headed Bunting or Rock Ptarmigan at all. Texts, photos and units are not made yet. Photos: all species but Common Pheasant use approved photos from production; the Pheasant picks are from unreviewed candidates and need approving on /trip-photos. The home bird European Herring Gull has no approved photos on production: its photos are the same unreviewed picks the Baltics and French trips use, so approve them on /trip-photos.
